# Actual independent 3.2 review findings

Reviewed source 3c10b6d056b1b160db47c7f603693502e78e0c71; tree 2263f1cc01c12b0eb19b5c2a4dff356371f9925b. These are the reviewer’s completed dispositions, based on the preserved original and corrected observations. Earlier interim notes retain their historical pending state.

## D14-3.2-001 — medium, resolved

Irreversible revalidation commit failures now recover even without a history write. Failed committed adapter sessions are detached and disposed before bounded recovery, including exhausted journals; generation checks preserve newer reentrant/async authority. Independent original/fixed browser controls and 12 recovery/native tests support the repair. Current packed navigation/ownership/security campaigns and exact final source bind it.

Current compatibility/release/qualification documentation identifies 3.2 as eight packages and three starters. Published 3.0/3.1 seven-package receipts and earlier router development evidence retain their historical identities. The final 57-row ledger and 49 indexed evidence files were independently verified.

## D14-3.2-003 — low, resolved

The source advisory gate explicitly covers the current native-router starter through the version-selected inventory. Independent ten-control replay verifies native-only advisory/unreachable/missing-starter refusal and historical behavior. Fresh current P17 also passes source and packed advisory/signature gates. All three shipped consumer workflows now enforce scripts-off complete npm installation, registry signatures, full npm advisories and pinned cargo-deny with live database fetch before builds. ## D14-3.2-005 — medium, nonblocking

Bootstrap credential metadata shows broader package/org write authority, 2FA bypass and a seven-day expiry rather than the requested package-only/one-day credential. The human explicitly authorized the finite exception after disclosure, as relayed and recorded by the parent. The source restricts use to the first exact @getforma/router 3.2.0-rc.1 qualified archive and strips credentials from other npm children; it does not reduce registry authority if leaked. Immediate GitHub secret removal and npm revocation after publication, actual trusted-publisher enrollment/first trusted publication and live monitoring remain mandatory operational obligations. No least-privilege or completed-enrollment claim is accepted.

Click interception reads the raw href and resolves it against the committed view during a held POP; missing href is not synthesized into navigation. The original three-engine failure, corrected 12-case replay and full 117-case history campaign retain their actual source identities. The two removed irreversible assignments were immediately overwritten unconditionally and did not create a new callback boundary.

Five-package observer defaults and eight-package registry policy are prepared before the audit freeze, removing the runbook requirement for prohibited post-RC source edits. Independent 43-test replay verifies missing-router 404/nonzero/incomplete/no snapshot, immutable historical baseline, expansion/shrink behavior and missing package/record/hash rejection. Preexisting policy data and historical inventory readers are unchanged. Configuration is not live enrollment or a successful registry observation.

The first uncertain-outcome announcement repeats the warning sentence and doubles punctuation. This is a visible/live-region wording defect, not an observed speech failure. The general Mac checklist confirmation does not refute it. I accept the whole-release D14 review of prepared Forma 3.2.0-rc.1 source 3c10b6d056b1b160db47c7f603693502e78e0c71, tree 2263f1cc01c12b0eb19b5c2a4dff356371f9925b, at 2026-10-27T00:52:51Z. The blocking-findings list is empty. This is my actual independent judgment after source, requirements, evidence and final-diff review; the validator only checks the record's consistency.

I am the separate fresh-context reviewer /root/release_32_independent_audit, session 01a17a33-88ea-7203-ab65-a3be82993362, actual OpenAI gpt-6-astra with ultra effort. The actual parent spawn specifies fork_turns: none and the reviewer session has a separate identity. L-65 permits this same-model fresh-context review. I did not author or edit implementation, install packages, commit source, publish, or close gates. Model/initialization evidence contains selected actual metadata fields only, with original-record hashes; no parent conversation, credential, hidden reasoning or prompt/configuration text is included.

Scope: accepted Forma v2 requirements and founder decisions, FORMA-301 research/design/API/measurement/57-row acceptance contracts, SR14/SR17/SR33, all eight packages and all three starters. I reviewed router history and commit authority, cancellation/reentry, browser/native ownership and disposal, typed transport/action admission, one-send POST and uncertainty handling, bounded safe GET recovery, scroll/prefetch/resource limits, strict policy/build/context identities, compiler and build closed executable graphs, Rust typed pages/actions, capability/version compatibility, package/public resolution, source and consumer supply-chain gates, publisher bootstrap and monitoring preparation, P17/performance, full core mutation accounting, D14/final/soak gates, documentation and historical evidence boundaries. Published 3.0/3.1 limitations and records were not relabeled as 3.2 proof or silently erased.

Exact input binding: the full tracked path/mode/blob manifest contains 5001 entries. The tree is clean. All eight versions are 3.2.0-rc.1. From measured 4c59 to this tree only the reviewed qualification Markdown/JSON, historical-ledger link and release-contract statuses/scopes changed; no product or qualification harness changed. Compared with 4948, only the two current evidence documents and three non-audit RC closures changed. Documentation, candidate and publisher-preparation closures are supported by actual evidence. The audit row and all final obligations remain pending at the reviewed input. All 57 ordered requirement IDs and 49 indexed evidence-file sizes/SHA-256s revalidate.

Current hosted candidate proof: workflow_dispatch 40423336544, attempt 1, pack job 121922872362 and verify job 121923298833 are authenticated through independent provider metadata and full original job logs. Original artifact 12699851463 is 60,410,745 bytes with ZIP SHA-256 2c5cac3c43c00405a1e0f0b14668730ef421f2723e4f449866fc1fdf5c917b3e; all 214 extracted files authenticate. DS11 SHA-256 573866aafb8bfebbf3a0f50eea9dbf4d24deb95d5ce28d8d58468b4c0f212869 binds all eight original candidate archives to 4c59 and this run. P17 SHA-256 64b421156a709feabe1c67df478fc331e0a8e631493880bfa720f2a649f04e59 contains 75 unique passing checks in 1240.829s against 1800s, all three starters, public packed resolution, template byte equality, registry signatures/advisories, worker integrity/lifecycle, three-engine deployment skew and complete owned-process cleanup.

I rehashed all 198 raw performance journal records, matched eleven original producer source hashes, and authenticated the actual published 3.1 predecessor record from GitHub. All five N1 shapes retain 20,000 raw samples each and pass absolute 1.5M nodes/s and strict greater-than-half predecessor floors; independently recomputed p99 rates are 4.852M/7.378M/6.703M/6.982M/8.786M. Decoder p95 is 8.6/20.5ms. Forty cold mobile visits have p95 TBT 0 and no exceptional startup tasks; raw traces, independent activation observations and causal dead/slow/slow-input controls validate. The three client-comparison engines retain their raw samples. The packed hostile campaign contains 2082 cases, 30 capability, 9 explicit-mount and 3 observer controls; the 100,000-case expression campaign and actual removed-guard/removed-cost mutations retain failing counterfactuals and passing original/corrected runs.

Original full Nightly 40412642649 attempt 1 measured 98889302. Independent provider/artifact authentication and all 993 mutation raw files, 4 expression and 5 hostile files match their original ZIPs. I independently reclassified every original process/report/log triple using the unchanged strict assertion classifier and checked completed assertion records without retries: 326/328 caught, 2 actual survivors, 0 equivalent, 0 unqualified, 99.3902% versus 85%; 169/169 security and 98/98 expression caught. Before/restored baselines both execute the same 4320 identities/states with 0 skips. The list-threshold NaN-key survivors remain genuine coverage gaps in the denominator. The declared 617 input path/mode/blob closure is byte-identical from measured 988 through this final tree. I additionally located and proved unchanged 20 cross-repository parity/archive files read by core tests. This supports campaign applicability, not a fabricated execution on the final commit or universal mutation adequacy for router/server code.

Fresh current 4c59 installed-archive native 90/90 and paired size evidence authenticate exact eight archives, original binary/assets and clean ownership. Incremental gzip 12287/12288 bytes and group 40715/65536 bytes pass unchanged caps, leaving one byte incremental headroom. Detailed tar-member comparison from 862d to 4c59 proves only crate VCS and authenticated checksum cascades; four npm product archives are byte-identical. Thus scoped 862d supplementary campaigns apply while keeping their actual identity: 117 history cases; 1500 resource cycles / 18 deliberate omitted-cleanup detections; 44 API/model limits, 2 scroll regressions and 45 real-browser limits; 90 strict-policy action cases plus 3 separate duplicate-core diagnostics and 2 lock-only peer resolutions; 54 scroll/prefetch checks; four fixed timing cells at 0.5/3/1/3.10ms conservative commit p95. The one action-driver rAF to 25 ms polling correction preserves the predicate and 20 s deadline, and original failures remain. Source/HappyDOM/synthetic/public/native/diagnostic scopes remain explicit.

One real public no-cache/no-cookie Chromium BFCache restore now shows trusted persisted original Document/token, synchronous root revocation, and exactly one recovery GET/new Document. This witnesses common coordinator H03 behavior; private/native no-store and all-engine eligibility are not claimed. The earlier no-store attempt remains not-exercised. The human's actual general reply “ok done all good” confirms the six requested Mac Safari keyboard/VoiceOver/Reduce Motion tasks; no individual speech transcript is invented, and it does not refute finding 009. Physical iPhoneHTTPS/gesture acceptance and real deployed-site/cache/cookie/proxy behavior remain final obligations.

Nine stable findings are retained: 001/002/003/004/006/007/008 resolved; 005 medium bootstrap-authority residual and 009 low duplicate uncertain-warning text nonblocking for this RC. The 86 default-branch alerts were independently scoped to 50 archived snapshots and 36 benchmark competitor dependencies, with no matched vulnerable versions in active candidate locks; fresh candidate advisory checks still govern, and archived/competitor risks are not dismissed. Historical core partial-render recovery/performance limitations remain separate from the router change.

This acceptance qualifies the prepared RC audit only. It does not approve stable publication, declare FORMA-301 complete, claim physical iPhone or production rollout acceptance, or grant a 3.2 post-final soak waiver. Exact final main/tag CI and tagged P17 must execute for the release. The finite router bootstrap remains the explicitly authorized credential exception; immediate secret removal/token revocation, actual publisher enrollment/first trusted publish and live five/eight-package observations require real receipts after first publication. Stable release requires the remaining final milestone obligations and at least 3600 seconds of actual continuous fault-free published-RC burn-in after P17/D14. The 3.0-specific scheduling exception does not carry over. After this review, only the exact audit pending-to-done flip, the audit records, and independently reviewed permitted documentation/changelog changes are allowed; no product/harness/version normalization or later non-audit gate closure is authorized by this report.

The original failed P17/native/fixture/driver attempts and the 8ee post-proof target-binary overwrite remain identified. The modified 8ee binary supplies no original replay credit; current isolated proofs authenticate their own binaries. No threshold, security policy, missing-package failure or requirement was waived to turn these results green.
